stemEn: A child has recent upper respiratory symptoms, hepatomegaly, and elevated liver enzymes after a parent used an over-the-counter medication for the illness. Which substance is implicated in the source recall?

options.text: Other recalled options were not preserved in the source

explanationAr: المصدر يختار paracetamol ويعرض السيناريو كـ repeated supratherapeutic acetaminophen exposure مع hepatotoxicity.
reasoningEn: The source links OTC paracetamol exposure with hepatic injury in this recall.
incorrectOptionsAr: بقية الخيارات لم تُحفظ في المصدر، لذلك لم تتم إضافتها من الذاكرة.
clinicalPearl: Repeated supratherapeutic acetaminophen exposure can present with liver injury even without a single large ingestion history.

stemEn: A child develops acute vomiting and diarrhea with heme-positive stool, and the mother is pregnant. Which household medication is the most likely exposure among the listed options?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار iron ingestion؛ وجود maternal iron tablets في المنزل مع acute GI symptoms وheme-positive stool هو clue رئيسي.
reasoningEn: The source treats severe gastrointestinal symptoms after access to pregnancy supplements as classic iron poisoning.
incorrectOptionsAr: Folic acid وparacetamol لا يفسران بحسب المصدر هذا النمط من hemorrhagic GI irritation بنفس القوة.
clinicalPearl: Pregnancy iron tablets are a classic accidental pediatric poisoning source.

stemEn: A child has acute gastrointestinal symptoms and an abdominal radiograph shows multiple radiopaque tablets consistent with iron ingestion. Which treatment is selected from the listed choices?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار deferoxamine من الخيارات المعطاة، لكنه يذكر أيضًا أن whole-bowel irrigation قد يكون جزءًا من management في حالات محددة. لذلك لا أعتبر المسار العلاجي مكتملًا دون تحقق حديث.
reasoningEn: The recall identifies iron toxicity and selects the chelator deferoxamine among the provided options.
incorrectOptionsAr: Naloxone antidote للـopioids، والـlaxative وحده ليس العلاج النوعي الذي اختاره المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Iron tablets can be radiopaque; treatment depends on severity, serum iron and clinical status.
managementSteps: Full decontamination/chelation pathway requires independent verification.

stemEn: An 11-year-old girl has rigidity, myoclonus, delirium, tachycardia, mydriasis, seizure, dry skin, mild hyperthermia, absent bowel sounds, and a distended bladder. Which listed drug class is the most likely exposure?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار tricyclic antidepressant toxicity؛ وجود anticholinergic findings مثل dry skin، mydriasis، ileus وurinary retention مع seizure/tachycardia هو محور السؤال.
reasoningEn: The source interprets the anticholinergic toxidrome plus seizures/cardiac findings as TCA toxicity.
incorrectOptionsAr: Benzodiazepines وbarbiturates غالبًا يسببان CNS depression بدل anticholinergic excitation؛ amphetamine لا يفسر dry skin/ileus/urinary retention بنفس النمط حسب المصدر.
clinicalPearl: TCA overdose can combine anticholinergic features, seizures and dangerous cardiac toxicity.

stemEn: What acid-base pattern is expected in salicylate poisoning according to the source recall?

options.text: Other recalled options were not preserved in the source

explanationAr: المصدر يختار mixed metabolic acidosis + respiratory alkalosis كنمط كلاسيكي في salicylate toxicity.
reasoningEn: Salicylates can produce a mixed acid-base disorder; the source specifically preserves this pattern.
incorrectOptionsAr: بقية الخيارات غير محفوظة في المصدر، لذلك لم تتم إضافتها.
clinicalPearl: A mixed respiratory alkalosis and metabolic acidosis is a classic salicylate exam pattern.

stemEn: Which arterial blood gas pattern best matches aspirin toxicity among the listed options?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار A لأنه يجمع low HCO3 مع low pCO2، أي metabolic acidosis مع respiratory alkalosis.
reasoningEn: Option A shows the mixed low-bicarbonate and low-CO2 pattern emphasized by the source for salicylate toxicity.
incorrectOptionsAr: الخيارات الأخرى لا تعطي نفس الـmixed pattern الذي يورده المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Do not interpret salicylate ABGs as a simple single-process acidosis.

stemEn: A poisoned child has pH 7.24, pCO2 24, and HCO3 8. Which listed toxin is favored by the source?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار aspirin؛ كلاهما قد يسبب high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis، لكن انخفاض pCO2 الشديد هنا ينسجم مع respiratory alkalosis المصاحبة للـsalicylate toxicity.
reasoningEn: The source distinguishes salicylate toxicity by the accompanying respiratory alkalosis/low CO2.
incorrectOptionsAr: Methanol قد يسبب metabolic acidosis، لكن المصدر يفضل aspirin بسبب نمط الـhyperventilation والـlow pCO2.
clinicalPearl: Low bicarbonate plus disproportionately low CO2 should raise salicylate toxicity in the right context.
